evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index fell sharply from 22 to 15 on June 18, reflecting acute deterioration into Extreme Fear after a brief mid-month rebound toward 23. Over the past 30 days, sentiment has been depressed with a 30-day mean of 19.83 and a 7-day mean of 17.57. While extreme fear can historically precede contrarian accumulation over medium-term horizons, immediate 24-hour intervals following sharp sentiment drops often reflect ongoing selling momentum, fragility, and lack of aggressive spot buying support. Given the contract requirement that a tie resolves downward and the prevailing depressive momentum, the probability of BTC closing higher over the 24-hour horizon is modestly tilted downward at 0.46.
limitations: Sentiment indices like Fear & Greed aggregate past volatility and volume and can lag rapid intraday price shifts.
Extreme Fear acts as a contrarian indicator over longer multi-week horizons but carries lower directional certainty over a strict 24-hour window.
